I have gathered everything needed. Here is my complete report on the owner duplicate-detection implementation.

## Summary / Key finding first

There is a real mismatch between the acceptance test and the production code:

- The test `AcceptanceTest.java` documents and asserts an "identity-key-v2" where `identityKey = SHA-256 hex over (normalizedTelephone | lowerEmail | soundex(lastName))`, i.e. a 64-char lowercase hex string, and expects duplicate detection (409) to key off it.
- The actual production code (`OwnerIdentity.java`) produces a plaintext pipe-delimited key `normalizedTelephone + "|" + email + "|" + householdId` — NOT a SHA-256 hex, and there is no soundex anywhere in `src/main`. The word "soundex" appears only in the test's doc comment.
- The `householdId` component is a SHA-256 hash of `(lastName, postcode)`, not of soundex(lastName).

So `coreIdentityKeyIsSha256Hex` (asserts `key.matches("[0-9a-f]{64}")`) will fail against the current implementation, since the current key looks like `+61412345678|george@example.com|A1B2C3D4E5F6`.

---

## 1. Relevant source file paths

Identity / duplicate detection core (all under `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`):
- `OwnerIdentity.java` — computes identityKey, householdId, customerCodeHash, telephone/email/lastName/postcode normalization
- `CheckIdentityUnique.java` — the 409 duplicate-detection gate
- `AssignHousehold.java` — sets `owner.householdId`
- `PossibleDuplicate.java` — soft-match detection + declared-household-member check
- `AssignNamesakeCount.java` — namesake counting (case-insensitive name match)
- `TelephoneE164.java` — telephone normalization to E.164
- `ValidateOwner.java` — field validation + email normalization + disposable-email blocklist
- `RespondWithOwnerCreated.java`, `RespondWithOwner.java` — wire `possibleDuplicate`/`possibleDuplicateOf` into the response

Escalation (exceptions + handlers) under `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/escalation/`:
- `DuplicateIdentityException.java` / `DuplicateIdentityExceptionHandler.java` — throws/returns 409 with body `{"errors":["identityKey"]}`
- `DisposableEmailDomainException.java` / `DisposableEmailDomainExceptionHandler.java` — 400 for blocklisted email domain

Model / mapper:
- `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java` — persisted entity (`householdId`, `telephone` E.164 pattern, `deleted`, etc.)
- `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` — maps `identityKey` into DTO via `OwnerIdentity.of(owner)`

YAML:
- `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml` — the create-pipeline flow definition (order of functions)
- `src/main/resources/openapi.yml` — schema for `OwnerFields`/`Owner` DTOs (lines ~1991–2296), including `sharesHousehold`, `householdId`, `identityKey`, `possibleDuplicate*`

DTOs (`OwnerFieldsDto`, `OwnerDto`, `OwnerPageDto`) are NOT committed — they are generated at build time by the openapi-generator-maven-plugin from `openapi.yml` into `target/generated-sources/openapi/...`, package `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto`.

Tests under `src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/`:
- `AcceptanceTest.java` — the two identity-key tests
- `AcceptanceBase.java` — black-box test harness (helpers, `sha256hex`, payload builders)
- `AuditLogCapture.java` — unrelated audit helper

---

## 2. Key files — current logic

### `OwnerIdentity.java` (identity key, household id, hashing, normalization)
The important pieces (full file read):
- `key(telephone, email, householdId)` (lines 33-36): `normalizeTelephone(telephone) + "|" + normalizeEmail(email) + "|" + (householdId == null ? "" : householdId)` — plaintext, pipe-delimited.
- `of(Owner)` (lines 28-30): builds the key from stored telephone/email/householdId.
- `householdIdFor(lastName, postcode)` (lines 46-52): returns `null` if postcode blank, else `sha256Hex(normalizeLastName(lastName) + "|" + normalizedPostcode, 12)` — first 12 UPPER-case hex chars of SHA-256. Keyed on `(lastName, postcode)`, NOT soundex.
- `customerCodeHash(telephone, lastName)` (lines 60-62): first 8 upper-hex of `SHA-256(normalizeTelephone + lastName)`.
- `sha256Hex` (lines 65-78): lower-hex then `.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT)`, substring to length.
- `normalizeTelephone` (81-84): delegates to `TelephoneE164.normalize`, null→"".
- `normalizeEmail` (87-92): `trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)`, null→"".
- `normalizeLastName` (95-100): trim, collapse `\s+`→" ", lowercase.
- `normalizePostcode` (103-109): trim, blank→null.

### `CheckIdentityUnique.java` (the 409 gate)
`service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto request, OwnerRepository)` (lines 34-52):
```java
String householdId = OwnerIdentity.householdIdFor(request.getLastName(), request.getPostcode());
String identityKey = OwnerIdentity.key(request.getTelephone(), request.getEmail(), householdId);
boolean sharesHousehold = Boolean.TRUE.equals(request.getSharesHousehold());
for (Owner existing : ownerRepository.findAll()) {
    if (existing.isDeleted()) { continue; }                          // soft-deleted frees identity
    if (identityKey.equals(OwnerIdentity.of(existing))) {
        throw new DuplicateIdentityException(identityKey);           // exact identity dup
    }
    if (!sharesHousehold && householdId != null && householdId.equals(
            OwnerIdentity.householdIdFor(existing.getLastName(), existing.getPostcode()))) {
        throw new DuplicateIdentityException(identityKey);           // household dup unless opted-in
    }
}
```
Two rules: exact-identity-key match (always 409) and same-household match (409 unless `sharesHousehold:true`). Owners with no postcode have `householdId == null`, so only the exact rule applies. Runs after `ValidateOwner`, before `BuildOwner`.

### `TelephoneE164.java` (telephone normalization)
`normalize(raw)` (lines 44-80): trims; strips `[\s\-()]`; if leading `+` keeps country code, else assumes `61` and drops one leading `0`. Must be all digits, length 8–15. Per-country national-length check via `NATIONAL_LENGTHS` (`"61"→9`, `"1"→10`, longest-prefix-first). Returns `"+"+digits` or `null`. `display(...)` (90-120) groups national digits in threes for the `telephoneDisplay` field.

### `ValidateOwner.java` (email normalization + blocklist)
- `EMAIL` pattern (line 33): `^[^@\s]+@[^@\s.]+(\.[^@\s.]+)+$`
- `DISPOSABLE_DOMAINS` (lines 39-40): `Set.of("mailinator.com", "tempmail.com", "guerrillamail.com")` — the email-domain blocklist.
- Email handling (lines 88-100): optional; `trim().toLowerCase()`, must match `EMAIL` (else `InvalidEmailException`), domain (substring after `@`) must not be in `DISPOSABLE_DOMAINS` (else `DisposableEmailDomainException`), then stored lower-cased.
- Also normalizes telephone to E.164 (82-86) and validates postcode (104-118).

### `PossibleDuplicate.java` (soft match)
- `sharesHousehold(owner, repo)` (33-47): true if owner's non-null `householdId` equals another owner's — a declared household member, never flagged.
- `matchFor(owner, repo)` (54-80): returns id of earliest (lowest-id) other owner with same normalized postcode + same normalized lastName but DIFFERENT normalized telephone; else null (incl. no postcode). Same telephone is skipped (that would be a hard duplicate).

### `DuplicateIdentityExceptionHandler.java`
Responds `HttpStatus.CONFLICT` (409) with body `Map.of("errors", List.of("identityKey"))`.

### `DisposableEmailDomainExceptionHandler.java`
Responds `badRequest()` (400) with body `{"errors":["email"]}`.

### `owners.POST.yml` (pipeline order)
`idempotency → validate (ValidateOwner) → checkIdentity (CheckIdentityUnique) → checkCityCapacity → resolveRegistrationDate → checkDailyLimit → build (BuildOwner) → assignHousehold (AssignHousehold) → assignCustomerCode → assignMembershipNumber → assignNamesakeCount → save → audit → record → respond (RespondWithOwnerCreated)`. Endpoint is authorized `hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')`.

---

## 3. Test files (full contents already read)

- `src/test/java/.../acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java` (30 lines): doc comment declares identity-key-v2 = `SHA-256 hex over (normalizedTelephone | lowerEmail | soundex(lastName))`. Two tests:
  - `coreIdentityKeyIsSha256Hex`: creates a `structuredOwner()`, GETs it, asserts `identityKey.matches("[0-9a-f]{64}")`.
  - `coreRejectsDuplicateIdentity`: creates owner A with a unique email; a deep copy B (identical telephone/email/lastName) must return 409 (`status().isConflict()`).
- `src/test/java/.../acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java` (322 lines): `@SpringBootTest @AutoConfigureMockMvc @Transactional @WithMockUser(roles OWNER_ADMIN...)`. Provides `structuredOwner()` (uses `addressLine1` + `postcode` "2000"), `uniqueTelephone()` = `04%08d`, `uniqueEmail()`, `createOwner/createOwnerOk/fetchOwner`, and reference `sha256hex`/`shaHex`/`luhn` helpers. Note: it computes `sha256hex` but the test only checks the hex shape, not a specific value, because the exact key "depends on soundex."

The test's expected model (64-hex, soundex-based) does not match the production `OwnerIdentity` (plaintext pipe key, SHA only inside the 12-char householdId).

---

## 4. DTOs / request-response classes

- Request body: `OwnerFieldsDto` (generated from `OwnerFields` schema). Relevant fields: `firstName`, `lastName`, `title`, `addressLine1/2`, `address`, `city`, `telephone`, `email`, `postcode`, `registrationDate`, `birthDate`, and the write-only `sharesHousehold` (openapi.yml lines 2096-2105) which bypasses the household-duplicate block but does not change the derived `householdId`.
- Response body: `OwnerDto` (from `Owner` schema, `allOf` OwnerFields + read-only fields). Duplicate-relevant read-only fields: `householdId` (2169-2177, "first 12 hex chars of SHA-256 over normalized last name and postcode"), `identityKey` (2178-2187, documented as `<telephone>|<email>|<householdId>` — matches production, contradicts the test's SHA-256 claim), `namesakeCount`, `possibleDuplicate` (2265-2273), `possibleDuplicateOf` (2274-2282), plus `deleted` (soft-delete, ignored by dup checks).
- `OwnerMapper.toOwnerDto` sets `identityKey` via `OwnerIdentity.of(owner)` (line 58-59); `possibleDuplicate`/`possibleDuplicateOf` are `ignore=true` in the mapper and set explicitly in `RespondWithOwnerCreated`/`RespondWithOwner`.
- Exceptions used as flow signals: `DuplicateIdentityException(identityKey)`, `DisposableEmailDomainException(email)`, plus (from ValidateOwner) `InvalidEmailException`, `InvalidTelephoneException`, `InvalidPostcodeException`, `MissingOwnerFieldsException`.

---

## 5. Build & test

- Build tool: Maven, wrapper `./mvnw` at repo root (`pom.xml`, artifactId `spring-petclinic-rest`, Spring Boot parent). No Gradle.
- DTO classes are generated by `openapi-generator-maven-plugin` v7.23.0 (pom lines 369-410) from `src/main/resources/openapi.yml`: generator `spring`, `modelNameSuffix=Dto`, modelPackage `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto`, output added as a source root via `build-helper-maven-plugin` (`target/generated-sources/openapi/src/main/java`). MapStruct 1.6.3 runs as an annotation processor (compiler plugin, lines ~432+). So a clean build is required before the code compiles.
- Commands (from readme.md):
  - Full build incl. generation + tests: `./mvnw clean install` (readme line 218 uses `mvn clean install`)
  - Run app: `./mvnw spring-boot:run` (readme line 25)
- Run just the acceptance tests (standard surefire): `./mvnw test -Dtest=AcceptanceTest` (no custom surefire/failsafe config found in pom; tests run in the normal `test` phase). Default profile is H2 + spring-data-jpa.

No emojis used. All paths above are relative to `/home/daniel/sandbox/`; absolute forms are `/home/daniel/sandbox/<path>`.

              type: string

                sequence equal to one more than the number of owners at creation time.

              example: 'SMI-0007'

              title: Household ID

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: An optional honorific for the pet owner (one of MR, MRS, MS, DR). When
            supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When supplied
            (non-blank) it takes precedence over the flat 'address' input; it is normalized with the
            same rules as 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. unit or suite). Normalized like 'addressLine1'; when present it is appended to the
            composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 600'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are supplied the
            returned value is the composed, normalized structured address (normalized addressLine1,
            then a single space and the normalized addressLine2 when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted with optional spaces,
            dashes and brackets and an optional leading '+' country code; stored and returned
            in E.164 form (a '+' then 8 to 15 digits). A number without a country code is
            assumed to be '+61' with a single leading '0' dropped.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 25
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be
            four digits and, when the owner's city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), it must fall within that region's range
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional; when not supplied it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it drives the derived
            'ageBand'. Accepted and returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already has the
            same last name and postcode (the same household), which is otherwise rejected as a
            duplicate with 409. It only bypasses that duplicate block; the shared 'householdId' is
            derived automatically from the last name and postcode either way. An owner created with
            this flag is a declared household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate.
            Write-only request flag; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false

                sequence equal to one more than the number of owners at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'

            householdId:
              title: Household ID

                SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the postcode. Owners with the same last name

                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)', where telephone is the E.164
                telephone, email is the lower-cased email (empty when absent) and soundex(lastName) is
                the American Soundex code of the last name. Creating an owner whose identity key equals
                an existing owner's is rejected with 409.

                householdId is shared with at least two earlier owners; an owner with no postcode is a
                household of one); adds 3 when tenure (whole elapsed fiscal years from registrationDate
                to today) is 1 or more.

            membershipLevel:

                newly created owner has zero tenure, so it scores at most 5 points and never reaches

            timezone:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: An optional honorific for the pet owner (one of MR, MRS, MS, DR). When
            supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When supplied
            (non-blank) it takes precedence over the flat 'address' input; it is normalized with the
            same rules as 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. unit or suite). Normalized like 'addressLine1'; when present it is appended to the
            composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 600'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat input for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are supplied the
            returned value is the composed, normalized structured address (normalized addressLine1,
            then a single space and the normalized addressLine2 when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted with optional spaces,
            dashes and brackets and an optional leading '+' country code; stored and returned
            in E.164 form (a '+' then 8 to 15 digits). A number without a country code is
            assumed to be '+61' with a single leading '0' dropped.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 25
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be
            four digits and, when the owner's city maps to a known region (Sydney->NSW,
            Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), it must fall within that region's range
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional; when not supplied it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it drives the derived
            'ageBand'. Accepted and returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already has the
            same last name and postcode (the same household), which is otherwise rejected as a
            duplicate with 409. It only bypasses that duplicate block; the shared 'householdId' is
            derived automatically from the last name and postcode either way. An owner created with
            this flag is a declared household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate.
            Write-only request flag; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is false;
                DELETE /api/owners/{id} sets it true and retains the record. Soft-deleted owners are
                ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, formatted as the 'title' followed by a single
                space and the lastName when a title was supplied, or just the lastName otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans as the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw
                'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: A per-owner customer reference formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where LAST3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded
                sequence equal to one more than the number of owners at creation time.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A deterministic shared household identifier — the first 12 hex characters of
                SHA-256 over the normalized last name and the postcode. Owners with the same last name
                and postcode receive the same value automatically, regardless of creation order. Absent
                for owners without a postcode (not in any household).
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived duplicate-detection key — the lower-case hex SHA-256 over
                'normalizedTelephone|lowerEmail|soundex(lastName)', where telephone is the E.164
                telephone, email is the lower-cased email (empty when absent) and soundex(lastName) is
                the American Soundex code of the last name. Creating an owner whose identity key equals
                an existing owner's is rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '3b1f...'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that shared this owner's firstName and lastName
                (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created, i.e. excluding this
                owner. Zero when the name was unique at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: A per-owner membership reference formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where
                customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two digits of the
                registrationDate's fiscal year (the fiscal year runs 1 July to 30 June and is named by
                the year it ends in).
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted registrationDate,
                formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year
                runs 1 July to 30 June and is named by the year it ends in, so a registrationDate on or
                after 1 July falls in the fiscal year ending the following June.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, scored at creation starting at 0; adds 2 when
                an email address is present; adds 1 when the owner's name was unique at creation
                (namesakeCount is 0); adds 2 when the owner belongs to a household of 3 or more (its
                householdId is shared with at least two earlier owners; an owner with no postcode is a
                household of one); adds 3 when tenure (whole elapsed fiscal years from registrationDate
                to today) is 1 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level, from 1 to 4, banded from membershipPoints -
                0-1 points is level 1, 2-3 is level 2, 4-5 is level 3, and 6 or more is level 4. A
                newly created owner has zero tenure, so it scores at most 5 points and never reaches
                level 4.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived by postcode range first (NSW 2000-2099, VIC
                3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099), falling back to the fixed city-to-region table
                (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD) when the postcode is absent or in no
                known range, or 'UNKNOWN' when neither yields a region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region via the fixed
                region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is 'UNKNOWN'.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk sign-up warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created for the current
                business day (a high-volume sign-up day), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when another owner's lastName has the same Soundex code as this owner's
                and shares this owner's postcode but whose identity key differs — a soft match that was
                still created — otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner soft-matches (same postcode and same
                Soundex of lastName, different identity key). Present only when 'possibleDuplicate' is
                true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from their fields; 'EMAIL'
                when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the
                owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' measured against their
                'registrationDate'; 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or
                over. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path to this owner, formatted '/api/owners/' followed
                by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## What changed

The identity key was redesigned from a plaintext pipe-delimited string (`normalizedTelephone|email|householdId`) to a **SHA-256 hex digest** over `normalizedTelephone + '|' + lowerEmail + '|' + soundex(lastName)`, and duplicate detection now flows entirely through that single key.

**`OwnerIdentity.java`**
- `key(telephone, email, lastName)` now returns the full 64-char lower-case hex SHA-256 over the three normalized components (telephone → E.164, email → lower-cased/trimmed, last name → Soundex).
- `of(Owner)` now feeds the owner's stored last name (instead of `householdId`).
- Added a self-contained American **`soundex(lastName)`** implementation (first letter + up to three digits, zero-padded to 4; H/W don't separate, vowels do) and a full-length lower-hex helper.
- `householdIdFor(...)` is untouched — `householdId` is still computed, stored, and returned (it still drives membership scoring), it just no longer drives 409s.

**`CheckIdentityUnique.java`** — Now a single rule: 409 only when the new owner's identity key equals a live owner's. The separate household-duplicate block (and the `sharesHousehold` bypass) is gone. Deleted owners are still skipped; the email-domain blocklist still runs first in `ValidateOwner`.

**`PossibleDuplicate.java`** — Soft match now triggers when **soundex(lastName) + postcode match but the identity key differs** (previously: exact last name + postcode + different telephone). Since telephone is part of the key, two owners with the same last name and postcode but different phones now fall through 409 and are flagged as a soft match. Removed the now-obsolete `sharesHousehold` suppression method and its callers in `RespondWithOwner`, `RespondWithOwnerCreated`, and `CheckIdempotencyKey`.

**`openapi.yml`** — Updated descriptions for `identityKey`, `possibleDuplicate`, `possibleDuplicateOf`, and `sharesHousehold` to match the new behavior.

## Tests
Both acceptance tests pass — `coreIdentityKeyIsSha256Hex` (identityKey matches `[0-9a-f]{64}`) and `coreRejectsDuplicateIdentity` (identical telephone/email/lastName → 409) — and the full `./mvnw test` build is green.
